result.title: AcoustiPrint: Physics-Guided Neural Design of Manufacturable Acoustic Structures
result.summary: Recent work in additive manufacturing and neural inverse design enables the creation of complex three-dimensional structures to manipulate physical fields, yet these designs must also adhere to discrete, non-differentiable fabrication constraints. Current methods limit the design space by imposing differentiable soft manufacturability loss penalties, or by fixing structures through post-processing, causing a discrepancy between the geometry optimized by the physics model and the final fabricated result. Thus, we present AcoustiPrint, a physics-informed neural architecture for constrained inverse design that represents three-dimensional geometries with an implicit neural representation (INR) and passes each candidate through a printability operator before evaluating its final response. The printability operator executes layer-wise self-support, discrete material selection, and whole-body connectivity, assuring fabrication feasibility. To allow for backpropagation through the discrete non-differentiable operations, we use surrogate gradients for the backward pass and a self-supervised printability objective that progressively drives the INR toward a valid design domain. We demonstrate AcoustiPrint for personalized transcranial focused ultrasound, where inter-patient differences in acoustic properties and head geometry deform wave propagation and requires patient-specific acoustic focusing. AcoustiPrint jointly optimizes three-dimensional geometry and material composition through differentiable wave physics while ensuring manufacturability. Experiments show manufacturable acoustic structures with enhanced focal accuracy and over density-based and phase-based baselines, demonstrating a generalized methodology for neural design through non-differentiable manufacturing constraints and differentiable physics.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 AcoustiPrint，用隐式神经表示（INR）参数化三维声学结构，并在物理波传播评估前接入可打印性算子，配合代理梯度实现含离散不可微制造约束的可微逆向设计。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「INR 连续隐状态 + 对离散不可微算子用代理梯度训练」的思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的连续表示及不可微决策（如停止、证据筛选）的可训练化提供借鉴线索，但需核查其与多模态推理的实际距离。
